_help: One entry per video. 'file' = an .mp4 in this folder (put a poster picture in videos/posters/ and name it in 'poster'). Optional: 'captions' = a .vtt file in this folder, 'youtube' = a YouTube video ID instead of 'file'. 'transcript' is the text description shown under the video (needed for accessibility). Newest year first is automatic.
